how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-duskwood-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:221:obj:0: Kill 12 Nightbane Dark Runner worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
rows.quest:221:details:0: You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.
rows.quest:221:details:1: BOn my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.
rows.quest:221:completion:0: You performed well against the Dark Runners, ⟦1⟧. But it seems as though their numbers are inexhaustible. Every time we make progress, more spring up to refill their ranks.
rows.quest:221:completion:1: BWhat is the evil power that draws them here? Why have they come to disturb our unhappy realm...
rows.quest:221:completion:2: BI will put my faith in Master Carevin. No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
rows.quest:222:obj:0: Kill 8 Nightbane Vile Fang and 8 Nightbane Tainted One worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
rows.quest:222:details:0: Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.
rows.quest:222:details:1: BOf the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.
rows.quest:222:details:2: BFrom far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...
rows.quest:222:completion:0: ⟦2⟧, to be honest with you, I did not believe that you would get this far, but you are clearly a ⟦3⟧ to be reckoned with. In fact, if you wish to formally join Master Carevin's struggle, I will gladly write for you a letter of recommendation.
rows.quest:223:obj:0: Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
rows.quest:223:details:0: Here you go, ⟦4⟧. Bring this message to Master Carevin.
rows.quest:223:details:1: B<He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.>
rows.quest:223:details:2: BA few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.
rows.quest:223:completion:0: Excuse me for my cold reception, ⟦5⟧, but as I'm sure you can tell, I am an extremely busy man. I see that you have impressed Calor--and I assure you, that is no small feat--and that he has given his recommendation.
rows.quest:223:completion:1: BThere are unsavory types afoot, ⟦6⟧, and we can use the help of all who have proven themselves. We battle against demons, the undead, and those who would provide them aid. Be vigilant, be wary, and trust none who would not give aid to our cause.
rows.quest:225:obj:0: Speak with Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
rows.quest:225:details:0: The weathered grave marker reads simply:
rows.quest:225:details:2: B<Upon further examination, you notice that dirt over the grave has been recently disturbed, and that a good amount of the dirt seems to have been displaced...>
rows.quest:225:completion:1: BAhh, yes, of course. His was a long and sorrowful tale. I knew him, well, before he left for the war, but that was the last time I saw him. A noble and good man, he was, but he suffered a bad end.
rows.quest:225:completion:2: BHere, I should have something here that can tell the tale better than my own recollections...
rows.quest:226:obj:0: Kill 12 Starving Dire Wolves and 8 Rabid Dire Wolves, then return to Lars at ⟦E2⟧'s Camp on the western border of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:226:details:0: ⟦E2⟧ and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all. And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food. It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite. It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!
rows.quest:226:details:1: BBut if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it. They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
rows.quest:226:completion:0: Oh good. You thinned out that pack quite a bit, and without those wolves nipping out our heels, we can bind our minds to dealing with Morbent Fel.
rows.quest:226:completion:1: BHere, take some of these Flash Bundles. They make them in town, and a lot have been donated to ⟦E2⟧ to help with his cause.
rows.quest:227:obj:0: Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
rows.quest:227:details:0: <He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.>
rows.quest:227:details:1: BIf you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.
rows.quest:227:completion:1: BOh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story?
rows.quest:227:completion:2: BWell, I'll give you the short version. A wandering undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering ⟦E3⟧. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of ⟦E1⟧, of whom you apparently know. He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking ⟦E4⟧ on patrol and killing people.
rows.quest:227:completion:4: BYou seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.
rows.quest:228:obj:0: Kill Mor'Ladim, then return his skull to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
rows.quest:228:details:0: From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout ⟦E3⟧, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?
rows.quest:228:details:1: BThere isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
rows.quest:228:completion:0: You killed him? That's no small accomplishment, ⟦8⟧! On behalf of the people of Darkshire and the Night Watch, I thank you.
rows.quest:228:completion:1: BAh... there is one small matter, however...
rows.quest:229:details:0: I should have told you this earlier...
rows.quest:229:details:2: BMorgan may have believed that his family was all dead, but, in fact, his daughter ⟦E5⟧ is now a Watcher. She's always been troubled by the... circumstances... surrounding her father's death. Perhaps you could go to bring the news to her.
rows.quest:229:completion:2: BI wish... there was something I could have done for him... If only I had talked to him before he...
rows.quest:230:obj:0: Bring the Book from ⟦E2⟧'s Farm to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:230:details:0: Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.
rows.quest:230:details:1: BThe book has no title, but...it has information ⟦E2⟧ would like to know.
rows.quest:230:completion:0: <⟦E2⟧ reads the book's pages, then slams it shut.>
rows.quest:230:completion:1: BThat shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death! There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!
rows.quest:231:details:0: Here, take this and lay it on his grave. Maybe... somehow, he'll know that I'm okay, and that none of us hold him responsible for what happened.
rows.quest:231:details:1: B<There are tears in her eyes now, as she slides a ring from her right hand, and presses it into your hands.>
rows.quest:231:completion:0: <A ghostly voice sounds on the wind...>
rows.quest:231:completion:1: BThis is...? ⟦E6⟧? Could it be she's still alive? The weight is removed from my shoulders...
rows.quest:231:completion:2: B⟦11⟧. Take my sword, Archeus. As my soul is put to rest, I have no more need for it. It was forged to do good, and though I have proved myself unworthy to hold it, perhaps you will carry on the Light through it.
rows.quest:240:obj:0: Return to ⟦E7⟧ with the Dusky Crab Cakes.
rows.quest:240:details:0: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!
rows.quest:240:completion:0: Aha! Thank you, ⟦12⟧. Those really hit the spot!
rows.quest:240:completion:1: BAnd here, please let me pay you for these!
rows.quest:245:obj:0: Kill 15 Pygmy Venom Web Spiders, and then report back to Watcher Dodds in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:245:details:0: Hail, ⟦13⟧. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.
rows.quest:245:details:1: BI hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.
rows.quest:245:details:2: BOh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
rows.quest:245:completion:0: Ah! You're back. And not too much worse for wear, it'd seem. Of course, ⟦14⟧, the Night Watch is grateful for your work, and I did promise you a reward, so here.
rows.quest:251:obj:0: Bring the Letter to Ello to Sirra Von'Indi.
rows.quest:251:details:0: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi. He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.
rows.quest:252:obj:0: Bring the Translated Letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke
rows.quest:252:details:0: Oh my! If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.
rows.quest:252:details:1: BYou better bring the translated note back to Ello.
rows.quest:252:details:2: BAnd do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...
rows.quest:252:completion:0: <Ello reads the letter...and his face goes white. He then looks at you...>
rows.quest:252:completion:1: BAlthough the aid you gave Abercrombie may have been motivated from kindness, your actions have doomed our town.
rows.quest:252:completion:2: B<Ello becomes lost in his thoughts...>
rows.quest:253:obj:0: Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
rows.quest:253:details:0: The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories. He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza. To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.
rows.quest:253:details:1: BThis revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for human flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.
rows.quest:253:details:2: BHis heart is his power. Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats. Do this and his power will be broken.
rows.quest:253:completion:0: You've done it! The magic within his heart will be proof against the Embalmer's evil, and a powerful aegis over the town of Darkshire.
rows.quest:253:completion:1: BYou have done a great thing for our people, ⟦15⟧. Your name will remain in our annals forever.
rows.quest:262:obj:0: Take the book you found at ⟦E2⟧'s farm and show it to townsfolk in Darkshire.
rows.quest:262:details:0: I must know who was that skulker in the shadows I saw the night my family was killed!
rows.quest:262:details:1: BPlease, ⟦16⟧, you have shown your resourcefulness. Please find that shadowy figure. I must learn what secrets he holds!
rows.quest:262:details:2: BI do not have clues that you do not already know, but here - take the book you found at my farm. Perhaps some of the townsfolk can link this book with its owner.
rows.quest:262:completion:0: Hmm... Someone handled this book recently, someone who is driven by revenge. But the impressions left on it, at least the impressions from the original owner, are faint.
rows.quest:262:completion:1: BI can tell, however, that the original owner of this book is not a native of Darkshire.
rows.quest:265:obj:0: See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.
rows.quest:265:details:0: Here is your book back, ⟦17⟧, and I bid you fortune with your search. If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.
rows.quest:265:details:1: BAnd here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.
rows.quest:265:completion:0: Ah, yes. I sold this book a month ago to a shady person. He didn't tell me his name, but he was a nervous, jittery chap, always looking over his shoulder.
rows.quest:266:obj:0: Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.
rows.quest:266:details:0: Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.
rows.quest:266:details:1: BYou might want to expand your search to the inn. If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.
rows.quest:266:completion:0: Oh yeah, I remember this book. Its owner rented a room for a few days, and spent his nights at the bar, writing.
rows.quest:266:completion:1: BHe left town in a hurry, muttering about being hunted by...something. Last I saw him he was heading west out of town, looking for a new spot to hide.
rows.quest:266:completion:2: BThe first place he'd find to the west is Raven Hill...
rows.quest:268:details:0: The book you found was only half finished. I had to leave it at ⟦E2⟧'s farm when I fled there...
rows.quest:268:details:1: BHere. Take my completed journal to ⟦E2⟧. It describes more fully what happened at his farm.
rows.quest:268:details:2: BAlthough this journal has been my only company these past weeks, if giving it up keeps me from having to face ⟦E2⟧ and his wrath, then I do it willingly!
rows.quest:268:completion:0: This journal explains much to me, and sets me on the path against the dark riders! I have seen these riders in ⟦E3⟧, and have seen them speak with the wizard Morbent Fel, at the Forlorn Rowe.
rows.quest:269:obj:0: Give ⟦E7⟧' Completed Journal to Bishop Farthing in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:269:details:0: Go to the city of ⟦E8⟧ and speak with Bishop Farthing in the Cathedral of Light. Give him ⟦E7⟧' journal and tell him you mean to face Morbent Fel.
rows.quest:269:details:1: BAlthough ⟦E8⟧ has forsaken Darkshire, Farthing is a kind soul and very wise. He may help you on your quest to save us.
rows.quest:269:details:2: BYour mission is perilous, but hurry, ⟦18⟧. With each passing hour, the shadows of ⟦E3⟧ grow ever darker.
rows.quest:269:completion:0: <After reading the journal and hearing your intent...>
rows.quest:269:completion:1: BAn evil taint has gained a foothold within the already beleaguered ⟦E3⟧. I thank the Light we have a hero such as you to face it.
rows.quest:269:completion:2: BBut you must first prepare yourself for the coming trial...for the Necromancer Morbent Fel is immensely powerful, and has cast dark enchantments about himself to protect him from physical assaults. If you are to defeat him, you will need a weapon that is proof against these protections.
rows.quest:270:obj:0: Go to Menethil ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧, and speak with Glorin Steelbrow.
rows.quest:270:details:0: Years ago, the Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras sunk along the coasts of The ⟦E10⟧, an expanse of marsh north of the Dwarven kingdom of ⟦E11⟧. Aboard one ship was a load of Lightforge Iron.
rows.quest:270:details:1: BThis metal is precious to us, for items crafted from it strike with holy truth. If you are to face Morbent Fel, then you will need such a weapon.
rows.quest:270:details:2: BGo to Menethil ⟦E9⟧ and speak with my dwarven colleague Glorin Steelbrow. If that lost metal can be found, he'll know where to look.
rows.quest:270:completion:0: Lightforge Iron is a precious metal, but it sounds like your quest is a dire one. You've come a long way, ⟦19⟧. With luck, you might just find what you seek!
rows.quest:270:completion:1: BAnd if you do get the iron, I know who can fashion it into a weapon against this Necromancer you speak of in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:321:obj:0: Search the wreckage of The Flying Osprey in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:321:details:0: The shipwrecks off the shore here are the doomed Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras, burned and sunk by Red Dragons during the last Great War.
rows.quest:321:details:1: BThe Fleet hailed from Lordaeron, but one ship, an Elvish Destroyer: Flying Osprey, was with it. It was shipping a load of Lightforge Iron and joined the Third Fleet for protection. Ironic that it sunk to the same dragons...
rows.quest:321:details:2: BEnough history. The Flying Osprey is wrecked to the south of Menethil ⟦E9⟧. If you find the Lightforge Iron there, bring it to me.
rows.quest:321:completion:0: This chest is waterlogged, and its siding broken. Many claw marks mar both the inside and outside of the chest...as if Murlocs have searched through it and stolen its treasure.
rows.quest:321:completion:1: BBut tucked deep within the chest is a single Lightforge Ingot. Unfortunately, many more will be needed if enough metal to fashion a weapon is to be gained.
rows.quest:322:obj:0: Take the Crate of Lightforge Ingots to Grimand Elmore in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:322:details:0: There is a dwarven weaponsmith in the Dwarven District of ⟦E8⟧ who can craft with lightforge iron. His name is Grimand Elmore.
rows.quest:322:details:1: BI've packed the iron you found into a crate. Take it to Grimand and tell him your tale. I'm sure he'll oblige someone on a quest such as yours, and craft for you a weapon - a weapon to give even Morbent Fel worry!
rows.quest:322:completion:0: That is quite a tale you have. And lightforge iron! Not for years have I worked with such a metal. It will be an honor to craft with it again. And you must return to me later with the story of your battle against the Necromancer.
rows.quest:322:completion:1: BBut we get ahead of ourselves. First, your weapon against Morbent Fel...
rows.quest:323:obj:0: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:323:details:0: Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders. I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.
rows.quest:323:details:1: BYou have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.
rows.quest:323:completion:0: Your skill in combat, ⟦20⟧, can not be doubted. Your resolve may yet see us through to the end of Morbent Fel!
rows.quest:324:obj:0: Gather 5 Lightforge Ingots, then return to Glorin Steelbrow in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:324:details:0: Having grabbed the single lightforge ingot from the waterlogged chest, it is clear that murlocs have stolen the rest. Hunt the murloc raiders near the Flying Osprey wreckage for the lost lightforge iron.
rows.quest:324:completion:0: Ah, you found them! Now let's get this lightforge iron hammered into something useful, eh?
rows.quest:325:details:0: Here is the weapon against the fiend of which you spoke. You're all ready, ⟦21⟧. Best of luck to you, and I look forward to your tale of glory!
rows.quest:325:completion:0: Ah, this will be proof against the fiend Morbent Fel! Well done!
rows.quest:325:completion:1: BYou are ready. Morbent Fel will fall.
rows.quest:337:obj:0: Return the book: The History of ⟦E8⟧, to the ⟦E8⟧ Library.
rows.quest:337:details:0: Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of ⟦E8⟧" can still be read along its spine. Upon opening the book, the seal of the ⟦E8⟧ Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.
rows.quest:337:details:1: BIt looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...
rows.quest:337:completion:0: Oh my! This book hasn't rested on these shelves since before the rebuilding of ⟦E8⟧, years ago. It will have to be restored of course, it's in bad shape, but I would be honored to place it within our rare books collection.
rows.quest:337:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦22⟧. Please accept this as payment for returning the book!
rows.quest:401:obj:0: Wait a moment, then speak with Sirra Von'Indi again.
rows.quest:401:details:0: I'm almost finished translating that note. If you come back in a few moments I should be done.
rows.quest:401:completion:1: B<The air grows heavy, as if a thick, black curtain is drawn over the land...>
rows.quest:453:obj:0: Find the Shadowy Figure. Your clues:
rows.quest:453:obj:1: BHe is not native to Darkshire.
rows.quest:453:obj:2: BHe is a nervous, jittery person.
rows.quest:453:obj:3: BHe left Darkshire and headed west.
rows.quest:453:details:0: Good luck, ⟦23⟧. I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.
rows.quest:453:details:1: BIf he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.
rows.quest:453:completion:1: BYes, I'm the author of that book. You finally found me, eh?
rows.quest:453:completion:2: BWell if you read that journal...then you only know the half of it!
rows.quest:526:obj:0: Gather 5 lightforge ingots, then return to Glorin Steelbrow in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:526:details:0: You might have found one lightforge ingot in that chest, but that's not enough to craft anything decent!
rows.quest:526:details:1: BYou should go back there and look for more. Maybe the murlocs around that wrecked ship have lightforge ingots on them.
rows.quest:526:completion:0: Ah, you found them! Now let's get this lightforge iron hammered into something useful, eh?
rows.quest:1372:obj:0: Speak with Apothecary Faustin at Beggar's Haunt.
rows.quest:1372:details:0: Our expeditionary force was sent at Varimathras's behest to survey lower ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1372:details:1: BWhile out scouting I noticed a human Infiltrator spying on Beggar's Haunt. Before I could apprehend him, some of our orcish... brethren... captured him and took him to Stonard, their stronghold in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1372:details:2: BI want to... help... our orcish allies. They did not see our camp here but nonetheless I want to lend a hand.
rows.quest:1372:details:3: BWork with Faustin here to develop a... truth serum for our friend in Stonard.
rows.quest:1372:completion:0: Zraedus was just telling me about the nosey little Infiltrator before you arrived.
rows.quest:1372:completion:1: BQuite a problem, indeed. The last thing we need is a busybody sniffing around Beggar's Haunt.
rows.quest:1372:completion:2: BI am sure the orcs of Stonard would be quite anxious to hear what our friend has to say. Seeing that they are our allies, ahem, we must help them to get any information they can from the human.
rows.quest:1372:completion:3: BWork with me, ⟦25⟧, and we will deliver a truth serum to Stonard.
rows.quest:1383:obj:0: Apothecary Faustin at Beggar's Haunt needs 5 Shadow Panther Hearts, Mire Lord Fungus and a Deep Strider Tumor.
rows.quest:1383:details:0: I have just the right serum in mind. It will deal with the truth in precisely the way the truth should be dealt with.
rows.quest:1383:details:1: BFor this concoction I will need several Shadow Panther hearts from the Swamp. I also require the enchanted fungus off of the Mire Lord who resides there. I am sure one as able as you, ⟦26⟧, can persuade him to part with some.
rows.quest:1383:details:2: BNow the hard part will be locating a Deepstrider tumor from far-off ⟦E15⟧. Very rarely the giants there become ill and a tumor forms.
rows.quest:1383:completion:0: Splendid, ⟦27⟧! And just in time too. From what Zraedus tells me, the Infiltrator has recovered from his wounds and is ready to be questioned by the orcs.
rows.quest:1383:completion:1: BGive me but a moment to prepare the pois - I mean prepare the truth serum.
rows.quest:1388:obj:0: Give Faustin's Truth Serum to Deathstalker Zraedus at Beggar's Haunt.
rows.quest:1388:details:0: Everything is proceeding according to plan, ⟦28⟧. I want you to give this truth serum to Deathstalker Zraedus and he'll show you how to administer it.... properly.
rows.quest:1388:completion:0: I knew old Faustin would come up with something good! You were a tremendous help, no doubt.
rows.quest:1388:completion:1: BNow let's get down to business, shall we?
rows.quest:1391:obj:0: Take Zraedus's Brew to Infiltrator Marksen in Stonard.
rows.quest:1391:details:0: We need to operate with a certain amount of discretion. After all, it's not like you're going to waltz in there and convince the fool to drink Faustin's concoction here, right?
rows.quest:1391:details:1: BBut if there's one thing those humans cannot deny it's the booze. I'll take Faustin's serum and mix it into this ale. I guarantee the poor sap will show no reluctance when it comes to chug-a-lugging a brew.
rows.quest:1391:details:2: BMake haste to Stonard in the ⟦E13⟧, ⟦29⟧. And keep our little mission nice and quiet...
rows.quest:1391:completion:0: A drink for me? How kind. It's been days since they've allowed me to drink. Let me drink this down and then I'll tell you what I've learned....
rows.quest:1395:obj:0: Bring the Crate of Powerstones to Quartermaster Lungertz, before the powerstones expire.
rows.quest:1395:details:0: This crate of powerstones needs to go to Nethergarde Keep, in the ⟦E16⟧. They won't hold their power for long, so we can't ship them with the next caravan.
rows.quest:1395:details:1: BYou must take them, and you must take them quickly.
rows.quest:1395:details:2: BBring them to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep. To reach the keep, you must travel east through ⟦E17⟧, then east through the ⟦E13⟧, then south through the ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1395:details:3: BUse caution, ⟦30⟧. You will travel through dangerous lands, yet you must not fail.
rows.quest:1395:completion:0: Ah, the powerstones! The mages will be happy to see these!
rows.quest:1395:completion:1: BMany thanks, ⟦31⟧. I know your trip from Darkshire was not an easy one.
